div.div:
Notes
*1 The paths change; the volume does not
All four candidates reach the same single volume. A disposable
SVM and volume were created per candidate and deleted after the
run
*2 The authentication and authorization principal changes per
path
NFS uses the OS uid and permissions, S3 Access Points use AWS
IAM, and ONTAP REST uses an ONTAP credential and ONTAP
authorization
*3 The network boundary changes too
Candidates A / B / C-REST are in-VPC (an NFS mount, or the
cluster management LIF); candidate C reaches over the
VPC-external public S3 endpoint
